svg.title: SSH: verify the guest, keep the private key on the Mac
svg.desc: The repository sequence diagram with the administrative SSH alias anonymized. The Mac obtains the recorded public host key through a trusted host connection, pins it, verifies the guest, and authenticates using a signature from its own private key.

g.text: SSH: Mac private key stays on Mac, guest public host key is pinned
No private SSH key or SSH agent is copied/forwarded by this helper.
Guest host private key remains inside the guest.
This is ordinary SSH; Tailscale SSH is not enabled here.
Pi provider OAuth is a separate /login after connecting.
